work.abstract_text: We give elementary proofs of consequences of Dumont, Sidorov and Thomas (1999, Propositions 6.8-6.9) answering the questions collected by Coons in The Calkin-Wilf problems on ell-ary partition functions (arXiv:2611.08109v1, Section 1, CW2, and Section 3, final display and following sentence): the first-linear-maximum answer is affirmative and the strict-adjacency answer is negative. A two-digit branching bound gives uniformly sublinear growth below digit bound ell^2-1 and all integer-power maximum-growth thresholds. For 2<=q<=ell, the upper logarithmic exponent is log_ell(q) throughout (q-1)(ell+1)<=k<=q*ell-1. The zero lower exponents, endpoint summatory identity, and attaining digit constructions are compared with prior results. We also give a corrected replacement for the exponent printed in Coons's Theorem 4.

work.title: Elementary proofs of Dumont-Sidorov-Thomas growth bounds for Calkin-Wilf's and Coons's partition questions
